findings.title: Resting-home wiring unpinned: boot/run-reset/deselect/ESC call sites have no driving test — reverting any to camera_set_fit passes the entire suite
findings.detail: The feature's headline behavior (resting home on entry/reset/deselect/ESC) is pinned only at the callee (camera_set_default called directly). All three wiring call sites are mutation-invisible; the harness captures at camera-fit and never exercises app camera wiring. Verified: zero tests drive effect_cancel/start_run/deselect — only comments reference them.
findings.fix: Add app-package tests driving the real entry points — effect_cancel via the cancel hook, the selection-diff deselect, start_run — asserting cam targets == DEFAULT_ZOOM / home anchor.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
findings.detail: P0 100% (tier/home/floor math + sim immunity; core 261, render 81, app 43, 49-demo harness, palcheck all verified green at sha). P1 ~45%: 0/4 resting triggers wired, vacuous puck cap, sub-default band unpinned. Overall ~70% — P1 < 80%.
findings.fix: Ship the wiring tests (effect_cancel, deselect, start_run), the PUCK_GROWTH_MAX unit pin, and the sub-default band pin — lifts P1 to >= 90% and the gate to PASS.

findings.title: Auto-pullback is inert at/below DEFAULT_ZOOM: the z_to>=zoom guard fires from the floor clamp — designed tradeoff at 2.0, undocumented dead band below 2.0, zero pins in both
findings.detail: For any zoom in [1.0, 2.0) (reachable wheel-out), z_to floors to 2.0 >= zoom -> active=false: distant districts trigger nothing (the old 1.0 floor eased out to reveal them). At exactly 2.0 the same guard no-ops — documented as the accepted tradeoff, but neither band has a failing-capable pin, and the function comment does not state the sub-default suppression.
findings.fix: Decide the sub-default band (keep suppression = document + pin active=false at zoom 1.5/2.0 with a far district, or ease up to DEFAULT_ZOOM); one doc sentence + two pin cases.

findings.title: PR body claims palcheck floors were re-pinned; no palcheck change exists in the diff and the commit message says the opposite
findings.detail: The declared spec (PR body IS the spec) asserts a re-pin that never happened; the commit message states 'palcheck stays green (floors had margin) - no re-pin needed'. Verified at the sha: harness palcheck all green with untouched floors. The spec text misleads review and future re-pin archaeology.
findings.fix: Amend the PR body: replace the re-pinned sentence with the commit message's truth — floors had margin, palcheck stayed green, no re-pin needed.

findings.title: camera_set_fit is orphaned (zero call sites) while its comment claims the 'explicit OUT LIMIT' role that actually lives in effect_zoom's CAM_ZOOM_MIN clamp
findings.detail: All resting call sites migrated to camera_set_default; repo-wide grep finds only the definition and comments. The real out limit is main.odin:1991's clamp. Retained 'framing' is misleading dead weight (compiles fine — odin does not reject unused package procs).
findings.fix: Delete camera_set_fit (recoverable from git history), or reword the comment to past tense; keep a pin that the wheel floor is CAM_ZOOM_MIN.

findings.title: PUCK_GROWTH_MAX cap never binds on shipped sprites and has no unit pin — deleting the min() clamp fails no test
findings.detail: Shipped ratios: puck_2 150/132=1.136, puck_3 168/132=1.273 — both under 1.30, so min() is a no-op on every shipped sprite (verified from assets/sprites/sprites.json). Removing the cap changes zero pixels and zero tests fail. Disclosed as future-proofing, but unpinned — the mutation-leg shape (font r5 gate-10 precedent).
findings.fix: Unit-pin sprite_puck_target with a synthetic Sprite_Sheet (bbox ratio > 1.30 clamps to exactly 1.30) plus tier ordering puck_1 < puck_2 < puck_3.

findings.title: Tier ladder's 'non-overlapping by construction' claim is unenforced: focus tiers 2.3/2.6 are unnamed literals and the ladder test pins its own literals
findings.detail: Editing 2.3 -> 1.9 in camera_set_selection inverts the ladder (focus below the 2.0 default) and fails zero tests — the guard test compares against its own literals, not the code's values.
findings.fix: Hoist FOCUS_ZOOM_NODE :: 2.3 / FOCUS_ZOOM_LINK :: 2.6 into camera.odin beside DEFAULT_ZOOM; make camera_set_selection, camera_focus_pair, and the ladder test read the named constants.

findings.title: PR body's '48/48 green' T1 count is stale — the harness at this sha reports 49 demos
findings.detail: tools/harness.sh run prints 'harness: 49 demo(s) green'; the 49th demo (dublin_board) landed before this PR. Substance true (0 .t1 files changed, core 261 green); only the count is carried over from earlier PR bodies.
findings.fix: Update the count to the harness's actual '49 demo(s) green' (or drop the specific number).

findings.title: Dublin block growth (B) pinned only via pixel goldens — no unit pin of the block-vs-puck legibility ratio the directive names
findings.detail: Absolute sizes are pixel-pinned (any constant change shifts node frames red), but the relative property — 'a high-tier puck stays just above a terminal block instead of ~3x it' — is asserted nowhere.
findings.fix: Add a cheap unit pin comparing block footprint vs sprite_puck_target ordering so the legibility ratio cannot silently re-invert.

findings.title: camera_cluster_center computes the whole-topology centroid; its 'source cluster' contract holds only at the single call instant after fixture seeding
findings.detail: A pure function whose name promises cluster semantics but whose math is an all-nodes centroid; any future caller (or a start_run reordering) silently gets a whole-map centroid as the 'home'.
findings.fix: Rename to camera_topology_centroid (comment keeps the seeding-instant contract), or accept the fixture node ids explicitly.

findings.title: New cluster-center test spawns into a bare Topology with no teardown (leaks per run)
findings.detail: topology_spawn_node appends to growing arrays (heap); the test defers only catalogs_destroy while sibling tests defer run_destroy. Tests stay green (odin tolerates leaks) — hygiene only.
findings.fix: Add the topology teardown matching the file's convention.
